main_text.p: CETVM Capillatum uel Crinitum hanc belluam nomine, cuius caput tantum Olaus delineauit in Tabula. GERM. F. Ein Haarwal.

MONSTRVM hoc iubatum simul barbatumq; in mari glaciali Gruntlandiam, remotissimam ad Septentriones regionem; fac In explicatione quidem Tabulae nusquam eius meminit; ut neque M Vnicornis: cuius caput in eadem Tabula exhibuit. GERM. Zwey seltzame vnbekannte Meerwunder/ sollend im wan gesähen werden. Das mit dem horn auff dem kopff/ so es natü Einhorn genennt werden.
MONSTRVM Rhinoceroti simile (inquit Olaus) nasō & dorso : (Astacum potius) duodecim pedum. GERMAN. F. Ein Nasswal/ein Spitzwal.

VACCAE marinae (aut potius Bouis marini cetacei) caput, ut ipse nominat, in Oceano Septentrionali, pingente Olao, prominet huiusmodi. Plinius Cornutam inter belluas maris nominat, nec ullam eius descriptionem addit. Nos hāc Olai Vaccam sic nominare poterimus, neque enim cornutum alium piscem scriptores memorant, nisi Arietem. GERM. F. Ein Meerochs/ein Meerkü. n Olai Magni.

p.i: HACTENVS ex Olai Magni Tabula animalium quidem in Oceano uerorum, & uiuentium: sed non satis ueras aut ad uiuum depictas, ut facilè suspicor, eicones aliquot exhibuimus. His fabulosa prorsus, Equi Neptunij effigies subiungatur, &c.

page.notes: The right part of the page is cut away and blanked, so lines are cut off mid-word. Woodcut illustrations appear in the layout without printed text, except their captions. Several Fraktur words and Greek-free text; doubtful readings marked where the scan is faint, e.g. "Monocero" caption truncated by the cut. The cut-off margin is not transcribed. Large part of the page is blank or blanked out on the left; woodcuts of sea monsters are present and are not transcribed.
